title: Portland Scenic Flight by Envi Adventures
blurb:
Depart over the Columbia River with beautiful views of Oregon's largest city. With this flight you'll experience Portland in the most unique way, including gorgeous views of the Willamette and Columbia Rivers, downtown Portland's bridges and skyscrapers, and on a clear day, a snow capped Mt. Hood

**Flight times are approximations**

**Please note that this flight has a weight limit of 600 pounds per group.
